sentence: ATTENTION ALL PASSENGERS: THE 7:42 SERVICE TO MANCHESTER PICCADILLY HAS BEEN DELAYED BY APPROXIMATELY FORTY MINUTES DUE TO A SIGNALLING FAULT BETWEEN STOCKPORT AND CREWE. WE APOLOGISE FOR THE INCONVENIENCE AND ADVISE TRAVELLERS WITH ONWARD CONNECTIONS TO SPEAK TO A MEMBER OF STATION STAFF, WHO ARE AVAILABLE ON PLATFORM THREE AND AT THE TICKET BARRIER NEAR THE MAIN CONCOURSE EXIT.

WARNING: WET FLOOR. PLEASE PROCEED WITH CARE AROUND THE ENTRANCE TO THE EAST CORRIDOR. CLEANING IS IN PROGRESS AND THE TILES MAY BE SLIPPERY UNTIL FULLY DRY. STAFF HAVE BEEN ALERTED AND THE AREA WILL BE REOPENED AS SOON AS THE SURFACE IS SAFE. WE THANK YOU FOR YOUR PATIENCE AND ASK THAT YOU SUPERVISE CHILDREN CLOSELY UNTIL THE SIGNS HAVE BEEN REMOVED FROM BOTH ENDS OF THE WALKWAY.

FIRE DRILL AT 11 A.M. TODAY. WHEN THE ALARM SOUNDS, LEAVE THE BUILDING BY THE NEAREST MARKED EXIT AND ASSEMBLE AT THE DESIGNATED MUSTER POINT IN THE CAR PARK BEHIND BLOCK B. DO NOT USE THE LIFTS. DO NOT STOP TO COLLECT PERSONAL ITEMS. REMAIN AT THE MUSTER POINT UNTIL YOUR FLOOR WARDEN CONFIRMS THAT EVERYONE HAS BEEN ACCOUNTED FOR AND IT IS SAFE TO RE-ENTER.

PUBLIC NOTICE: STREET CLEANING WILL TAKE PLACE ON THE EAST SIDE OF GLADSTONE ROAD THIS THURSDAY FROM 8 A.M. UNTIL NOON. ANY VEHICLE REMAINING ON THE ROAD DURING THESE HOURS WILL BE TICKETED AND, IF NECESSARY, REMOVED AT THE OWNER'S EXPENSE. SIGNS HAVE BEEN POSTED AT BOTH ENDS OF THE STREET. PLEASE MAKE ALTERNATIVE PARKING ARRANGEMENTS WELL IN ADVANCE.

DANGER: HIGH VOLTAGE. AUTHORISED PERSONNEL ONLY BEYOND THIS POINT. CONTACT WITH EXPOSED EQUIPMENT MAY CAUSE SERIOUS INJURY OR DEATH. ENSURE THAT THE MAIN ISOLATOR IS LOCKED OUT AND TAGGED BEFORE ANY MAINTENANCE WORK IS UNDERTAKEN. IN THE EVENT OF AN INCIDENT, RAISE THE ALARM IMMEDIATELY USING THE NEAREST EMERGENCY CALL POINT AND DO NOT APPROACH THE CASUALTY UNTIL THE POWER HAS BEEN CONFIRMED ISOLATED.

LIBRARY NOTICE: THE READING ROOM WILL CLOSE AT 6 P.M. SHARP THIS EVENING FOR ANNUAL CARPET CLEANING. PLEASE RETURN ANY BORROWED REFERENCE MATERIALS TO THE FRONT DESK BY 5:45 AT THE LATEST. THE QUIET STUDY AREAS ON THE FIRST FLOOR WILL REMAIN OPEN UNTIL 9 P.M. AS USUAL, AND THE EXTERNAL BOOK RETURN SLOT IS AVAILABLE AT ALL HOURS FOR YOUR CONVENIENCE.

SEVERE WEATHER ALERT FOR THE COUNTY. HEAVY RAINFALL AND GUSTS UP TO 80 MILES PER HOUR ARE EXPECTED BETWEEN MIDNIGHT AND 6 A.M. ON SATURDAY. RESIDENTS ARE ADVISED TO SECURE LOOSE GARDEN FURNITURE, AVOID NON-ESSENTIAL TRAVEL, AND CHARGE ESSENTIAL DEVICES IN CASE OF POWER OUTAGES. EMERGENCY SERVICES MAY BE DELAYED RESPONDING TO NON-CRITICAL CALLS DURING THE WORST OF THE STORM.

STAFF NOTICE: PLEASE DO NOT LEAVE PERSONAL ITEMS IN THE KITCHEN OVERNIGHT. ANY FOOD REMAINING IN THE COMMUNAL FRIDGE BY 6 P.M. ON FRIDAY WILL BE DISPOSED OF AS PART OF THE WEEKLY CLEAN. REUSABLE CONTAINERS LEFT BEHIND WILL BE PLACED IN THE LOST PROPERTY BIN UNDER THE STAIRS. THANK YOU FOR HELPING TO KEEP THE SHARED AREAS HYGIENIC.

FLOOD WATCH IN EFFECT ALONG THE LOWER VALLEY. RIVER LEVELS ARE FORECAST TO RISE OVERNIGHT AND MAY OVERTOP THE EAST BANK NEAR THE OLD MILL BY EARLY MORNING. RESIDENTS IN THE LOW-LYING ZONES ARE ASKED TO MOVE VEHICLES TO HIGHER GROUND AND BE READY TO EVACUATE IF INSTRUCTED. SANDBAGS ARE AVAILABLE FROM THE PARISH HALL UNTIL 10 P.M. TONIGHT.

AIRPORT SECURITY REMINDER: LIQUIDS, AEROSOLS, AND GELS IN CONTAINERS OVER 100 ML MUST BE PLACED IN HOLD LUGGAGE. LAPTOPS AND LARGE ELECTRONIC DEVICES SHOULD BE REMOVED FROM HAND LUGGAGE AND SCREENED SEPARATELY. PLEASE REMOVE BELTS, COATS, AND METALLIC ITEMS BEFORE PROCEEDING THROUGH THE SCANNER, AND FOLLOW THE INSTRUCTIONS OF SECURITY STAFF AT ALL TIMES TO KEEP THE QUEUE MOVING SMOOTHLY.

I WENT TO THE NEW PIZZA PLACE ON THE HIGH STREET LAST NIGHT AND HONESTLY I'M NOT SURE WHAT THE FUSS IS ABOUT. THE BASE WAS FINE, THE TOPPINGS WERE NICE ENOUGH, BUT THE WHOLE THING JUST FELT LIKE A REGULAR DECENT PIZZA AT TWICE THE PRICE BECAUSE THE LIGHTING IS DIM AND THEY SERVE IT ON A WOODEN BOARD INSTEAD OF A PLATE.

I SAW DAVE AT THE SUPERMARKET THIS MORNING AND HE LOOKS GREAT. HE'S BEEN GOING TO THE GYM AT 6 A.M. AND HE'S OFF THE BEER, SO OF COURSE HE'S DOING WELL. WE HAD A LONG CHAT BY THE CHEESE COUNTER ABOUT HIS NEW CONSERVATORY, WHICH HE DESCRIBED AS LIFE-CHANGING, AND I PRETENDED TO BE INTERESTED.

WE WERE GOING TO GO CAMPING THIS WEEKEND BUT THE WEATHER HAS TURNED. NOW WE'RE THINKING OF DRIVING UP TO THE COAST FOR THE DAY INSTEAD, GETTING FISH AND CHIPS, AND COMING HOME BEFORE THE TRAFFIC GETS HORRIBLE. I'D RATHER BE COLD ON A BEACH THAN COLD IN A TENT, AND AT MY AGE THE TENT IS NO LONGER NEGOTIABLE.

DID YOU SEE THE THING ABOUT THE FOX IN THE FRONT GARDEN AT NUMBER FOURTEEN? APPARENTLY IT'S BEEN COMING ROUND EVERY EVENING AND THEY'VE STARTED LEAVING IT FOOD. THE WHOLE STREET HAS OPINIONS. PAT SAYS IT'S DISGRACEFUL, JOAN SAYS IT'S CHARMING, AND I SAY IT'S NONE OF MY BUSINESS BUT I'D RATHER NOT FIND HALF A CHICKEN ON MY DOORMAT, THANK YOU.

I'M ABSOLUTELY EXHAUSTED. WORK HAS BEEN RELENTLESS THIS WEEK AND I'VE BEEN SAYING YES TO TOO MANY THINGS IN THE EVENINGS. ALL I WANT FOR THE WEEKEND IS A LONG LIE-IN, SOMETHING GREASY FOR BREAKFAST, AND ABSOLUTELY NO ONE TEXTING ME ABOUT ANYTHING. IF YOU SEE ME OUTSIDE BEFORE NOON ON SATURDAY, PLEASE ASSUME I HAVE BEEN KIDNAPPED.

YOU WOULDN'T BELIEVE WHAT HAPPENED ON THE BUS. THIS WOMAN HAD A FULL-SIZE HOUSEPLANT ON HER LAP, A FERN OR SOMETHING, AND EVERY TIME WE WENT OVER A SPEED BUMP IT BRUSHED THE FACE OF THE MAN SITTING NEXT TO HER. HE TRIED TO BE POLITE ABOUT IT FOR THREE STOPS AND THEN JUST GAVE UP AND CLOSED HIS EYES.

I'VE STARTED MAKING BREAD AGAIN. THE FIRST LOAF WAS A LITTLE DENSE, THE SECOND ONE WAS RAW IN THE MIDDLE, BUT THE THIRD WAS GENUINELY DECENT, AND I'M GOING TO RIDE THAT MOMENTUM UNTIL THE FOURTH ONE INEVITABLY HUMBLES ME. THERE IS SOMETHING DEEPLY SATISFYING ABOUT KNEADING DOUGH WHEN THE REST OF THE WEEK HAS BEEN ALL TYPING AND OPINIONS.

MY MUM RANG THIS MORNING TO TELL ME ABOUT A DREAM SHE HAD IN WHICH I WAS A LIGHTHOUSE KEEPER, AND ALSO TO ASK IF I COULD PICK UP HER PRESCRIPTION ON THE WAY OVER. I LOVE HOW SEAMLESSLY SHE CAN MOVE FROM THE METAPHYSICAL TO THE PRACTICAL WITHOUT ACKNOWLEDGING THE TRANSITION. THE LIGHTHOUSE THING IS STILL ON MY MIND, HONESTLY.

I ACCIDENTALLY BOUGHT TEN KILOS OF ONIONS. I MISREAD THE LABEL AT THE WHOLESALER AND NOW THE KITCHEN SMELLS LIKE A FRENCH BISTRO ON A BAD DAY. IF YOU ARE LOOKING FOR ONIONS, PLEASE COME ROUND. I AM ALSO TAKING APPLICATIONS FOR PEOPLE WHO WOULD LIKE TO TEACH ME HOW TO READ A SHOPPING LIST PROPERLY, A SKILL I CLEARLY DO NOT POSSESS.

WE BINGED THE WHOLE SERIES OVER THE WEEKEND AND I AM RUINED FOR ALL OTHER TELEVISION. THE LAST EPISODE HAD ME PACING THE LIVING ROOM AT 1 A.M. WONDERING WHETHER TO TEXT EVERYONE I KNOW TO WATCH IT IMMEDIATELY OR TO RESPECT THE FACT THAT THEY HAVE LIVES. I COMPROMISED BY TEXTING ONLY THE PEOPLE WHO DEFINITELY DO NOT HAVE LIVES.

BREAKING: LOCAL COUNCIL VOTES TO APPROVE CONTROVERSIAL HOUSING DEVELOPMENT ON GREEN BELT LAND AFTER A FIVE-HOUR PUBLIC HEARING. RESIDENTS' GROUPS HAVE VOWED TO APPEAL THE DECISION, CITING CONCERNS OVER FLOOD RISK AND PRESSURE ON LOCAL SCHOOLS. THE DEVELOPER HAS WELCOMED THE OUTCOME AND SAYS CONSTRUCTION ON THE FIRST PHASE OF 240 HOMES WILL BEGIN BEFORE THE END OF THE FINANCIAL YEAR.

MARKETS OPEN SHARPLY LOWER AFTER OVERNIGHT INFLATION DATA SURPRISES ANALYSTS. THE POUND HAS WEAKENED AGAINST THE DOLLAR AND BANK STOCKS LEAD THE DECLINES IN EARLY TRADING. ECONOMISTS SAY THE PRINT INCREASES THE PRESSURE ON THE CENTRAL BANK TO HOLD RATES AT THE NEXT MEETING RATHER THAN BEGIN THE EASING CYCLE THAT MOST OBSERVERS HAD EXPECTED THIS SPRING.

STORM HARRIET MAKES LANDFALL ON THE SOUTH-WEST COAST OVERNIGHT WITH WINDS OF UP TO 95 MILES PER HOUR. SEVERAL THOUSAND HOMES ARE WITHOUT POWER AND FERRY SERVICES ACROSS THE CHANNEL HAVE BEEN SUSPENDED. EMERGENCY CREWS ARE WORKING TO CLEAR FALLEN TREES FROM MAJOR ROUTES AND THE MET OFFICE HAS WARNED THAT FURTHER GUSTS ARE LIKELY UNTIL LATE AFTERNOON.

SCIENTISTS AT A LONDON RESEARCH HOSPITAL ANNOUNCE PROMISING RESULTS FROM AN EARLY-PHASE TRIAL OF A NEW IMMUNOTHERAPY FOR ADVANCED PANCREATIC CANCER. THE TEAM REPORTS A MEASURABLE REDUCTION IN TUMOUR SIZE IN A SMALL GROUP OF PATIENTS AND CAUTIOUS OPTIMISM ABOUT EXPANDING THE TRIAL TO A LARGER COHORT IN THE COMING YEAR, PENDING REGULATORY APPROVAL AND FURTHER FUNDING.

PRIME MINISTER ANNOUNCES SNAP CABINET RESHUFFLE FOLLOWING WEEKEND OF POLITICAL TURBULENCE. TWO SENIOR MINISTERS HAVE RESIGNED AND A THIRD HAS BEEN MOVED TO A DIFFERENT BRIEF AS THE GOVERNMENT ATTEMPTS TO REASSERT CONTROL AHEAD OF NEXT MONTH'S BUDGET. OPPOSITION LEADERS HAVE CALLED THE CHANGES COSMETIC AND ARE PUSHING FOR AN EARLY GENERAL ELECTION.

POLICE HAVE CONFIRMED THAT THE MAN ARRESTED IN CONNECTION WITH THE ART THEFT FROM THE NORTHERN GALLERY ON TUESDAY MORNING HAS BEEN CHARGED AND WILL APPEAR IN MAGISTRATES' COURT LATER TODAY. THREE OF THE FOUR MISSING PAINTINGS HAVE BEEN RECOVERED IN GOOD CONDITION, AND THE INVESTIGATION INTO THE WHEREABOUTS OF THE FOURTH PIECE REMAINS ONGOING.

TECH GIANT REPORTS RECORD QUARTERLY PROFITS ON THE BACK OF STRONG DEMAND FOR ITS NEW LINE OF AI-ENABLED PRODUCTS. SHARES JUMPED MORE THAN 7 PERCENT IN AFTER-HOURS TRADING, AND THE COMPANY HAS RAISED ITS GUIDANCE FOR THE FULL YEAR. ANALYSTS WARN, HOWEVER, THAT CAPITAL SPENDING ON NEW DATA CENTRES IS NOW RUNNING WELL AHEAD OF EARLIER FORECASTS AND COULD PRESSURE MARGINS LATER.

WORLD LEADERS GATHER IN GENEVA FOR EMERGENCY TALKS ON THE WORSENING HUMANITARIAN CRISIS IN THE REGION. AID AGENCIES SAY THAT WITHOUT A CEASEFIRE WITHIN THE NEXT FORTY-EIGHT HOURS, MEDICAL SUPPLIES IN THE WORST-AFFECTED AREAS WILL BE EXHAUSTED. NEGOTIATORS HAVE DESCRIBED THE EARLY ATMOSPHERE AS CONSTRUCTIVE BUT ADMIT THAT SIGNIFICANT DIFFERENCES REMAIN ON THE QUESTION OF MONITORING AND VERIFICATION.

ENGLAND HAVE BEATEN AUSTRALIA BY SEVEN WICKETS IN THE FOURTH TEST AT HEADINGLEY TO LEVEL THE SERIES AT TWO MATCHES ALL. A CENTURY FROM THE CAPTAIN AND A FOUR-WICKET HAUL IN THE SECOND INNINGS WERE THE STANDOUT PERFORMANCES. THE DECIDING FIXTURE BEGINS AT THE OVAL ON THURSDAY, AND TICKETS FOR ALL FIVE DAYS WERE REPORTED TO HAVE SOLD OUT WITHIN HOURS.

A MASSIVE COASTAL CLEAN-UP OPERATION IS UNDER WAY AFTER A CARGO SHIP LOST SEVERAL CONTAINERS IN ROUGH SEAS OFF THE NORTH-EAST COAST. TRAINERS, RUBBER DUCKS, AND BOXES OF PRINTER PAPER HAVE BEEN WASHING UP ON BEACHES FOR THREE DAYS. THE COASTGUARD HAS ASKED THE PUBLIC NOT TO COLLECT ITEMS THEMSELVES AND TO REPORT ANY SIGHTINGS TO THE LOCAL AUTHORITY.

PREHEAT THE OVEN TO 180 DEGREES CELSIUS. WHISK THE EGGS AND SUGAR IN A LARGE BOWL UNTIL PALE AND THICK. SIFT IN THE FLOUR AND FOLD GENTLY WITH A METAL SPOON UNTIL JUST COMBINED. POUR INTO A LINED LOAF TIN AND BAKE FOR THIRTY-FIVE MINUTES, OR UNTIL A SKEWER INSERTED INTO THE CENTRE COMES OUT CLEAN. ALLOW TO COOL IN THE TIN FOR TEN MINUTES BEFORE TURNING OUT.

BEFORE ASSEMBLING THE BOOKCASE, LAY OUT ALL THE COMPONENTS ON A FLAT SURFACE AND CHECK THEM AGAINST THE PARTS LIST. ATTACH THE SIDE PANELS TO THE BOTTOM SHELF USING THE LONGER SCREWS, MAKING SURE NOT TO OVER-TIGHTEN. SLIDE THE BACK PANEL INTO THE GROOVES AT THE REAR BEFORE FITTING THE TOP, AS IT WILL BE DIFFICULT TO INSERT ONCE THE FRAME IS FULLY ASSEMBLED.

TO RESET YOUR ROUTER, PRESS AND HOLD THE SMALL BUTTON ON THE REAR PANEL FOR APPROXIMATELY TEN SECONDS UNTIL ALL THE FRONT LIGHTS FLASH TOGETHER. RELEASE THE BUTTON AND WAIT FOR THE DEVICE TO FULLY POWER UP, WHICH MAY TAKE UP TO THREE MINUTES. RECONNECT YOUR DEVICES USING THE DEFAULT NETWORK NAME AND PASSWORD PRINTED ON THE STICKER UNDERNEATH THE ROUTER.

WATER YOUR NEW TOMATO PLANTS DEEPLY EVERY TWO TO THREE DAYS DURING WARM WEATHER, AIMING THE WATER AT THE BASE RATHER THAN THE LEAVES. PINCH OUT THE SIDE SHOOTS AS THEY APPEAR TO ENCOURAGE A SINGLE STRONG MAIN STEM. FEED WEEKLY WITH A HIGH-POTASSIUM TOMATO FOOD ONCE THE FIRST TRUSS OF FRUIT HAS SET, AND STAKE THE PLANTS SECURELY TO PROTECT THEM FROM WIND.

FILL OUT SECTION A IN BLACK INK, USING CAPITAL LETTERS, ONE CHARACTER PER BOX. DO NOT WRITE OUTSIDE THE MARGINS OR USE CORRECTION FLUID. IF YOU MAKE A MISTAKE, DRAW A SINGLE NEAT LINE THROUGH THE INCORRECT ENTRY AND INITIAL THE CHANGE. RETURN THE COMPLETED FORM, TOGETHER WITH THE SUPPORTING DOCUMENTS LISTED ON PAGE THREE, TO THE ADDRESS GIVEN AT THE TOP OF THIS LETTER.

WARM THE PAN OVER A MEDIUM HEAT AND ADD A SPLASH OF OIL. WHEN THE OIL IS SHIMMERING, ADD THE CHOPPED ONION AND A PINCH OF SALT, AND COOK UNTIL THE ONION IS SOFT AND TRANSLUCENT BUT NOT BROWNED. STIR IN THE GARLIC AND COOK FOR ANOTHER MINUTE, THEN ADD THE TOMATOES AND THEIR JUICE. SIMMER FOR TWENTY MINUTES, STIRRING OCCASIONALLY, BEFORE SEASONING TO TASTE.

PUT THE CAR INTO NEUTRAL AND APPLY THE HANDBRAKE FIRMLY BEFORE OPENING THE BONNET. LOCATE THE OIL DIPSTICK, WHICH USUALLY HAS A BRIGHT YELLOW HANDLE, AND PULL IT OUT. WIPE IT CLEAN WITH A LINT-FREE CLOTH, REINSERT IT FULLY, AND THEN PULL IT OUT AGAIN TO CHECK THE LEVEL. THE OIL SHOULD SIT BETWEEN THE TWO MARKS NEAR THE BOTTOM OF THE STICK.

WHEN PERFORMING CPR ON AN ADULT, PLACE THE HEEL OF ONE HAND ON THE CENTRE OF THE CHEST AND THE OTHER HAND ON TOP, INTERLOCKING YOUR FINGERS. PRESS DOWN FIRMLY TO A DEPTH OF ABOUT FIVE TO SIX CENTIMETRES, AT A RATE OF ROUGHLY TWO COMPRESSIONS PER SECOND. CONTINUE UNTIL EMERGENCY HELP ARRIVES OR THE PERSON STARTS BREATHING NORMALLY ON THEIR OWN.

MEASURE THE WINDOW FRAME CAREFULLY BEFORE CUTTING THE TIMBER, AND ALWAYS DOUBLE-CHECK YOUR FIGURES. MARK YOUR CUT LINE WITH A PENCIL AND USE A TRY SQUARE TO MAKE SURE IT IS PROPERLY PERPENDICULAR. WEAR EYE PROTECTION AND CLAMP THE WORKPIECE SECURELY BEFORE USING THE SAW. TAKE YOUR TIME AND LET THE BLADE DO THE WORK RATHER THAN FORCING IT THROUGH THE GRAIN.

TO WASH WOOLLEN GARMENTS BY HAND, FILL A BASIN WITH LUKEWARM WATER AND ADD A SMALL AMOUNT OF GENTLE DETERGENT. SUBMERGE THE GARMENT AND PRESS IT GENTLY THROUGH THE WATER FOR A FEW MINUTES, AVOIDING ANY RUBBING OR WRINGING. RINSE IN CLEAN WATER OF A SIMILAR TEMPERATURE, ROLL THE GARMENT IN A TOWEL TO REMOVE EXCESS WATER, AND DRY FLAT IN A SHADED SPOT AWAY FROM DIRECT HEAT.

I HAVE SPENT THE ENTIRE MORNING ON HOLD WITH THE BANK AND I AM NOW ON MY THIRD PERSON, NONE OF WHOM CAN APPARENTLY ACCESS THE SAME SYSTEM AS THE LAST ONE. I JUST WANT TO TRANSFER MY OWN MONEY OUT OF MY OWN ACCOUNT INTO ANOTHER OF MY OWN ACCOUNTS. THIS SHOULD NOT REQUIRE A COMMITTEE.

WHO LEFT THE DISHWASHER OPEN AGAIN. I HAVE WALKED INTO THE CORNER OF THE DOOR THREE TIMES THIS WEEK AND I AM RUNNING OUT OF UNBRUISED SHINS. IT TAKES ONE SECOND TO CLOSE IT. ONE. SECOND. I AM PREPARED TO HAVE A FULL FAMILY MEETING ABOUT THIS, COMPLETE WITH AN AGENDA, AT WHICH ATTENDANCE WILL BE MANDATORY.

THE TRAIN HAS BEEN CANCELLED. AGAIN. I CHECKED THE APP THIS MORNING, IT SAID THE TRAIN WAS ON TIME, I LEFT THE HOUSE, I QUEUED FOR A COFFEE, I WALKED ONTO THE PLATFORM, AND ONLY THEN DID A POLITE VOICE FROM A SPEAKER TELL ME THE WHOLE LINE IS DOWN UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE. THIS IS THE FOURTH TIME THIS MONTH AND I AM RUNNING OUT OF SYMPATHY.

I CAN'T BELIEVE I LOST THE DOCUMENT. I WAS WORKING ON IT FOR THREE HOURS, I HIT SAVE AT LEAST TWICE, AND THE PROGRAM CRASHED AND TOOK EVERYTHING WITH IT. THE AUTOSAVE FILE IS FROM YESTERDAY. WHY DOES IT EXIST IF IT IS NOT GOING TO DO THE ONE JOB IT WAS CREATED FOR. I AM TOO ANGRY TO START THE WHOLE THING AGAIN TONIGHT.

WHY ARE THERE ALWAYS EXACTLY TWO TILLS OPEN, ONE OF WHICH IS BEING USED BY A PERSON PAYING IN ENTIRELY UNCOUNTED SMALL COINS, WHILE THE OTHER ONE IS RESERVED FOR BASKETS UNDER TEN ITEMS, AND I HAVE ELEVEN. THE WHOLE SYSTEM IS DESIGNED TO TORMENT THE INDECISIVE SHOPPER AND I AM CONSIDERING WRITING A STERNLY-WORDED LETTER TO HEAD OFFICE ABOUT IT.

I HAVE TRIED EVERY POSSIBLE PASSWORD I HAVE EVER USED, INCLUDING THE EMBARRASSING ONES, AND NOTHING IS WORKING. THE WEBSITE HAS NOW LOCKED ME OUT FOR TWENTY-FOUR HOURS, WHICH FEELS LIKE A PUNISHMENT WILDLY OUT OF PROPORTION TO THE CRIME OF FORGETTING. I WILL BE LOGGING IN TOMORROW AT 9:01 A.M. WITH A FOUL EXPRESSION AND A NOTE-TO-SELF NEVER TO USE THIS SERVICE AGAIN.

I HAVE ASKED FOUR TIMES FOR THE ASSEMBLY INSTRUCTIONS IN ENGLISH AND BEEN SENT THE SAME PDF IN DUTCH ON ALL FOUR OCCASIONS. I DO NOT SPEAK DUTCH. I DO NOT WANT TO LEARN DUTCH. I WOULD LIKE A CHAIR THAT IS ACTUALLY A CHAIR, ASSEMBLED IN A WAY THAT MAKES SENSE TO MY ENGLISH-LANGUAGE BRAIN, AND I WOULD LIKE TO STOP RECEIVING AUTOMATED REPLIES THANKING ME FOR MY PATIENCE.

THE BUILDERS NEXT DOOR HAVE STARTED DRILLING AT 7:03 IN THE MORNING. SEVEN. OH. THREE. THE NOISE BYLAW STARTS AT EIGHT. I KNOW THIS. THEY KNOW THIS. WE BOTH KNOW THIS. I AM STANDING IN MY KITCHEN IN A DRESSING GOWN, HOLDING A COLD CUP OF COFFEE, AND CONSIDERING MY OPTIONS, NONE OF WHICH ARE LEGAL OR DIGNIFIED.

I JUST OPENED THE PACKAGE AND THE WRONG ITEM IS INSIDE. I ORDERED A BOOK ABOUT TUSCAN COOKING AND I HAVE BEEN SENT A MOTORCYCLE HELMET. NOTHING ABOUT THE PACKAGING SUGGESTED THIS WAS A POSSIBILITY. CUSTOMER SERVICE HAS PUT ME ON HOLD AND IS PLAYING ME THE INSTRUMENTAL VERSION OF A SONG I USED TO LIKE, WHICH I AM NOW BEGINNING TO RESENT DEEPLY.

WHY IS THE SCREEN ON THE PETROL PUMP ASKING ME ELEVEN QUESTIONS BEFORE IT WILL DISPENSE FUEL. NO, I DO NOT WANT A CAR WASH. NO, I DO NOT WANT A LOYALTY CARD. NO, I DO NOT WANT TO ROUND UP FOR CHARITY, BECAUSE I HAVE BEEN ROUNDING UP FOR THIS CHARITY AT EVERY GARAGE FOR YEARS AND I AM STARTING TO SUSPECT THEY ARE USING MY DONATIONS FOR THESE EXACT SCREENS.

TORNADO WARNING IN EFFECT FOR EASTERN OSCEOLA COUNTY UNTIL 9:45 P.M. RADAR HAS DETECTED ROTATION NEAR THE TOWN OF HARMONY MOVING NORTH-EAST AT THIRTY-FIVE MILES PER HOUR. TAKE SHELTER IMMEDIATELY IN A BASEMENT OR INTERIOR ROOM ON THE LOWEST FLOOR OF A STURDY BUILDING. STAY AWAY FROM WINDOWS AND COVER YOURSELF WITH BLANKETS OR PADDING IF DEBRIS BEGINS TO STRIKE THE STRUCTURE.

DENSE FOG ADVISORY THROUGH THE MORNING COMMUTE WITH VISIBILITY DROPPING BELOW A QUARTER MILE ACROSS THE LOWER OHIO VALLEY. MOTORISTS SHOULD USE LOW-BEAM HEADLIGHTS, INCREASE FOLLOWING DISTANCES, AND BE PREPARED FOR SUDDEN SLOWDOWNS NEAR RIVER CROSSINGS AND OVERPASSES WHERE THE FOG IS THICKEST AND TENDS TO LINGER WELL PAST SUNRISE.

EXCESSIVE HEAT WARNING IN PLACE FROM NOON TODAY THROUGH SUNSET ON FRIDAY. AFTERNOON HEAT INDICES WILL CLIMB BETWEEN 108 AND 114 DEGREES. LIMIT OUTDOOR EXERTION, CHECK ON ELDERLY NEIGHBOURS, AND NEVER LEAVE CHILDREN OR PETS IN PARKED VEHICLES. COOLING CENTRES ARE OPEN AT THE PUBLIC LIBRARY AND THE COMMUNITY RECREATION COMPLEX FROM 10 A.M. UNTIL 8 P.M. EACH DAY OF THE EVENT.

WINTER STORM WARNING POSTED FOR THE HIGHER ELEVATIONS OF THE CASCADES. EIGHTEEN TO TWENTY-FOUR INCHES OF SNOW ARE EXPECTED ABOVE 4,000 FEET, WITH RIDGETOP WINDS GUSTING TO SEVENTY MILES PER HOUR. TRAVEL OVER STEVENS AND SNOQUALMIE PASSES WILL BE EXTREMELY HAZARDOUS AND MAY BE CLOSED FOR EXTENDED PERIODS WHILE CREWS WORK TO MITIGATE THE AVALANCHE DANGER.

FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY FOR THE FRANKLIN AND BENTON CREEK DRAINAGES. NUMEROUS WATER RESCUES ARE UNDER WAY AND SEVERAL LOW-LYING ROADS HAVE BEEN COMPLETELY WASHED OUT. DO NOT ATTEMPT TO DRIVE THROUGH STANDING WATER. RELOCATE IMMEDIATELY TO HIGHER GROUND IF YOU ARE IN OR NEAR THE CHANNEL, AND DO NOT WAIT FOR INSTRUCTIONS BEFORE LEAVING IF WATER IS RISING AROUND YOUR HOME.

SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH UNTIL 11 P.M. ACROSS MOST OF THE STATE. THE PRIMARY THREATS INCLUDE QUARTER-SIZED HAIL, DAMAGING STRAIGHT-LINE WINDS UP TO SEVENTY MILES PER HOUR, AND THE POSSIBILITY OF ISOLATED TORNADOES AFTER DARK. SECURE LOOSE OUTDOOR FURNITURE AND BRING TRAMPOLINES, PATIO UMBRELLAS, AND TRASH BINS INDOORS OR INTO A GARAGE BEFORE THE LINE OF STORMS ARRIVES.

BLIZZARD WARNING IN EFFECT UNTIL NOON SUNDAY ACROSS THE NORTHERN PLAINS. SNOWFALL TOTALS OF EIGHT TO TWELVE INCHES COMBINED WITH SUSTAINED WINDS OF FORTY MILES PER HOUR WILL PRODUCE NEAR-ZERO VISIBILITY AND DEEP DRIFTING ACROSS RURAL ROUTES. NO TRAVEL IS ADVISED. IF YOU MUST GO OUT, CARRY BLANKETS, FOOD, WATER, AND A FULLY CHARGED PHONE IN CASE YOU BECOME STRANDED.

COASTAL FLOOD STATEMENT ISSUED FOR LONG ISLAND'S SOUTH SHORE BAYS. MINOR TIDAL FLOODING IS LIKELY DURING THIS EVENING'S HIGH TIDE NEAR 7:14 P.M., WITH WATER POSSIBLY ENCROACHING ONTO LOW-LYING ROADS IN MASTIC BEACH, FREEPORT, AND BABYLON. SHORE-FRONT RESIDENTS SHOULD MOVE VEHICLES OFF VULNERABLE SIDE STREETS AND CONSIDER RELOCATING SMALL CRAFT TIED AT EXPOSED DOCKS.

DUST STORM WARNING FOR PINAL AND PIMA COUNTIES. A FAST-MOVING WALL OF BLOWING DUST IS APPROACHING FROM THE SOUTH-EAST AND WILL CROSS INTERSTATE 10 NEAR PICACHO PEAK WITHIN THE NEXT THIRTY MINUTES. PULL ASIDE IF YOU ENCOUNTER ZERO-VISIBILITY CONDITIONS, TURN OFF YOUR HEADLIGHTS, REMOVE YOUR FOOT FROM THE BRAKE, AND WAIT UNTIL THE WALL HAS PASSED BEFORE PROCEEDING.

WIND CHILL ADVISORY OVERNIGHT INTO TUESDAY MORNING. APPARENT TEMPERATURES OF MINUS THIRTY TO MINUS FORTY DEGREES ARE FORECAST IN THE NORTHERN HALF OF THE FORECAST AREA. FROSTBITE CAN OCCUR ON EXPOSED SKIN IN AS LITTLE AS TEN MINUTES. DRESS IN LAYERS, COVER ALL EXPOSED SKIN, AND CHECK ON NEIGHBOURS WITHOUT RELIABLE HEAT BEFORE THE COLDEST HOURS BETWEEN MIDNIGHT AND DAWN.

AND THE BALL IS LOOSE IN THE FINAL MINUTE, RECOVERED BY THE DEFENCE AT THE THIRTY-EIGHT! THIS CHANGES EVERYTHING. THE CROWD IS ON ITS FEET, THE CLOCK IS TICKING DOWN, AND THE COACHING STAFF IS SCRAMBLING TO SET UP THE OFFENCE. WITH FIFTY-FOUR SECONDS LEFT AND ALL THREE TIMEOUTS, YOU HAVE TO LIKE THEIR CHANCES TO MARCH DOWN THE FIELD AND STEAL THIS ONE.

OH MY GOODNESS, WHAT A FINISH AT THE WIRE! THE FAVOURITE COMES CHARGING DOWN THE STRETCH, EVEN MONEY THERE AT THE EIGHTH POLE, AND IS RUN DOWN BY THE LONGSHOT IN THE FINAL STRIDE! PHOTO FINISH AT CHURCHILL DOWNS AND THE STEWARDS WILL HAVE TO SORT OUT THE PLACINGS, BUT IT LOOKED FROM THE BOOTH LIKE A BOBBING HEAD AT EXACTLY THE RIGHT MOMENT FOR NUMBER NINE.

HE TAKES THE THREE, FROM WAY DOWNTOWN, AND IT IS GOOD! UNBELIEVABLE! THE BENCH HAS EMPTIED, THE ARENA IS DEAFENING, AND THE OPPOSING COACH IS CALLING FOR TIME.
